subject: mathematics
question_text: If f: R→R and g: R→R are defined by f(x) = 3x − 1 and g(x) = x² + 1, find (gof)(2x − 3).

verification.note: Source: Sri Chaitanya, FAST TRACK IPE for Jr. Students — Mathematics-IA (2026-27 edition), book p.10, chapter 2 FUNCTIONS, Very Short Answer question 13(iii). Only the question was taken. The solution, the step order and the mark split are this answer book's own work — see docs/ORIGINALITY_MATHS.md. THE MARK SPLIT IS OURS, NOT THE BOOK'S: the Mathematics-IA volume prints no per-step mark allocation on any answer. The 1+1 split rewards the inner value f(2x − 3) = 6x − 10 first and the squared, simplified outer value second. Paper position: Maths-1A Section A runs Q1–Q10 at 2 marks each, all compulsory. This is a coaching publication, not a TSBIE document, so the split stays unverified until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

recall_prompt: Say how you would find (gof)(2x − 3) — which function acts first, and how the square is expanded.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Apply f to 2x − 3
steps.margin_note: First mark. f is the inner function in gof, so 2x − 3 goes into f. Multiply 3 across the whole bracket before subtracting 1.

recall.must_convey: That f acts first on 2x − 3, giving 3(2x − 3) − 1 = 6x − 10.
accept: f acts first so f of two x minus three is six x minus ten
three times two x minus three is six x minus nine then minus one
the inner function gives six x minus ten
modata f apply cheste six x minus ten vastundi
put two x minus three into f and get six x minus ten

steps.why: In gof the function on the right acts first, so the input 2x − 3 is put into f. The result 6x − 10 is what g will receive.
steps.memory_tip: In gof, f acts first. Multiply 3 into the whole bracket: 6x − 9, then subtract 1.
common_mistakes: Applying g first, which computes fog and gives a different expression.

steps.label: Apply g to that output
steps.margin_note: Second mark. g squares whatever it receives, so square the whole bracket 6x − 10 and then add 1.

recall.must_convey: That g squares the output 6x − 10 and adds 1, giving 36x² − 120x + 101.
accept: g of six x minus ten is six x minus ten all squared plus one
expand the square to thirty six x squared minus one twenty x plus one hundred then add one
the answer is thirty six x squared minus one twenty x plus one hundred and one
square cheste thirty six x square minus one twenty x plus hundred and one
square the whole bracket and add one

steps.why: g(x) = x² + 1 squares its input, and the input here is 6x − 10, not x. Squaring the whole bracket is where the middle term −120x comes from.
steps.memory_tip: (6x − 10)² = (6x)² − 2(6x)(10) + 10² = 36x² − 120x + 100. Never square the two terms separately.
common_mistakes: Writing (6x − 10)² as 36x² + 100 and losing the middle term.
